---
title: "The Miles Lab opens at Purdue"
date: 2026-10-08
categories: [lab news]
description: "We're setting up shop and recruiting our first lab members."
---

The Miles Lab is officially up and running at Purdue University! We'll study how cities and human activity shape the evolution of the organisms that live alongside us.

We're recruiting graduate students, postdocs, and undergraduate researchers. See the [Join the Lab](../../../join.qmd) page for details.
